summary: Iteration 4 targeted correction verification for BDesigner. Backend (9 pytest cases) and frontend (Requirement Form + Homepage Guarantees/Why-Choose) both pass all 20+ checklist items. Backend content migration replaced legacy guarantee + comparison rows with the new BDesigner product content. POST /api/requirement/price for architectural + 1800 sqft returns exactly ₹21,600 which matches the frontend live estimate. Frontend: 6 correct guarantee tabs, 9 correct why-choose rows, no legacy titles anywhere, tab icons neutral (dark in light theme = rgb(17,17,17), CTA in dark theme is near-white rgb(245,245,245) on black text rgb(11,11,11) matching spec). Requirement Form: selected service card shows subtle neutral surface (bg rgb(21,21,21), 1px rgb(41,41,41) border, no gold border) + single gold check svg; ReqField input wrappers all measure 54px; Step 2 base area ≈1,200 sqft auto-populates GF, GF persists when adding storeys, FF starts blank, Next disabled with inline req-floor-error-1 shown, total = sum of floors, summary total = ₹21,600 matches backend exactly; Step 3 has no fake map image, req-address-picker opens on req-change-location, picking a listed area shows 'Construction available'; Step 4 facing 52px + Vastu 52px; Step 5 purpose buttons 54px with 5 options in 2-col grid, 'Double Height Lobby' chip renders at ~61px height without clipping; Step 7 desktop shows summary once, mobile sticky footer contains only Edit + Continue buttons with NO duplicated price bar (req-price-bar not visible on step 7 mobile); Step 8 req-phone-disabled COMPLETELY removed, req-google-btn present with white bg + neutral border + 4 svg child nodes for the multicolor Google G, clicking it does NOT store any auth token (honest, no fake login), and email registration through req-create-account creates a new client account and closes the modal.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking (carried over from iter_3): RequirementForm.jsx is 579 lines and mixes step config, autosave, submit and CTA rendering. Consider splitting per-step components + a data-driven STEPS array with validators to reduce the growing if-chains in goNext().

Non-blocking (carried over from iter_3): CtaButtons is rendered twice in the DOM (mobile footer + desktop aside) so [data-testid='req-next'] etc. resolve to two nodes. Only one is visible per breakpoint (functionally correct), but Playwright's default first-match hits the hidden mobile one. Recommend either suffixing the desktop testid or conditionally rendering only one instance based on a JS media query.

Non-blocking: 'req-purpose' buttons at Step 5 do not have per-option data-testids (only the parent grid has data-testid='req-purpose'). Individual purpose options are not addressable for automation and analytics.
